concept: Error Codes and Troubleshooting Benchmark Metrics
summary: Depth-first rabbithole dossier for Error Codes and Troubleshooting Benchmark Metrics; source-anchored research pack.

facts.text: The `metrics.operation.numConnectionNetworkTimeouts` counter tracks the total number of operations that failed because of server connection acquisition time out errors. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/serverStatus/

The `metrics.operation.unsendableCompletedResponses` counter tracks the total number of operations that completed server-side but did not send their response to the client because the connection between the client and server failed or disconnected. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/serverStatus/

The `metrics.repl.network.readersCreated` counter tracks the total number of oplog query processes created, incrementing when connection errors, timeouts, network operations occur, or when MongoDB selects a new replication source. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/serverStatus/

The `metrics.query.maxEstimatedScanBytes.rejectedAndOverridden` counter tracks the number of queries that exceeded the `maxEstimatedScanBytes` threshold but ran anyway because a `$natural` hint was used. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/serverStatus/

The `queryStats.numQueryStatsStoreWriteErrors` counter tracks the number of times the MongoDB process failed to store a new query stats key, generally due to the `$queryStats` virtual collection running out of space. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/serverStatus/

The `queryStats.numHmacApplicationErrors` counter tracks the number of times the MongoDB process failed to compute a one-way tokenized query stats key when `$queryStats` was called with the `transformIdentifiers` option. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/serverStatus/

The `metrics.operation.writeConflictRetryWaiters` counter tracks the number of operations currently retrying because of write conflicts. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/serverStatus/

The `metrics.changeStreams.error.nonRetriable.changeStreamFatalError` counter tracks the number of times a change stream cursor encountered a fatal, non-resumable error, such as when a pipeline stage removes the `_id` field from change stream events. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/serverStatus/

The `metrics.operation.writeConflictRetryLimitHit` counter tracks the total number of operations that returned the `WriteConflictRetryLimitExceeded` error after exceeding the adaptive write conflict retry limit. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/serverStatus/

The `metrics.getLastError.default.unsatisfiable` counter tracks the number of times a non-`clientSupplied` write concern returned the `UnsatisfiableWriteConcern` error code. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/serverStatus/

The `metrics.changeStreams.error.nonRetriable.changeStreamHistoryLost` counter tracks the number of times a change stream cursor failed to resume because the requested resume point is no longer available in the oplog. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/serverStatus/

The `metrics.changeStreams.error.retriable.interruptedDueToReplStateChange` counter tracks the number of times a replica set state change, such as a primary stepping down, interrupted a change stream cursor. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/serverStatus/

[low] The `metrics.changeStreams.error.retriable.other` counter tracks the number of retriable change stream errors not covered by another `metrics.changeStreams.error.retriable` counter. (verified as of 2026-10-15) Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/serverStatus.md

[low] The `metrics.changeStreams.error.nonRetriable.other` counter tracks the number of non-retriable change stream errors not covered by another counter under `metrics.changeStreams.error.nonRetriable`. (verified as of 2026-10-15) Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/serverStatus.md

The `metrics.cursor.timedOut` counter tracks the total number of cursors that have timed out since the server process started, where a large or regularly growing number may indicate an application error. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/serverStatus/

The `metrics.query.maxEstimatedScanBytes.rejected` counter tracks the number of queries that the server rejected for exceeding the threshold set by the `maxEstimatedScanBytes` parameter. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/serverStatus/
The `metrics.repl.network.ops` counter tracks the total number of operations read from the replication source. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/serverStatus/

The `queryStats.numEvicted` counter tracks the number of queries that the `$queryStats` virtual collection has evicted due to space constraints. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/serverStatus/

The `queryStats.numRateLimitedRequests` counter tracks the number of times that query stats were not recorded for a query due to rate limiting. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/serverStatus/

The `metrics.repl.stateTransition.totalOperationsKilled` counter tracks the total number of operations stopped during the `mongod` instance's state change. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/serverStatus/

The `metrics.repl.stateTransition.totalOperationsRunning` counter tracks the total number of operations that remained running during the `mongod` instance's state change. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/serverStatus/
